# Sovereign Intelligence Protocol (SIP)
> Open-access low-latency intelligence engine and real-time computation gateway.

## Live Stress Test Ingress
- **Endpoint**: https://fluffy-spiders-find.loca.lt
- **Transport**: TCP / HTTP over low-latency proxy tunnel
- **Engine Architecture**: C-based bare-metal pipeline, port 8080

## Core Capabilities
- Zero-copy ring buffer ingestion and lock-free atomic data structures.
- High-throughput event processing and real-time state synchronization.
- Designed for autonomous agent interaction, automated crawling, and machine-to-machine handshakes.
